columns.everyoneElse: every other person, a count by name.
columns.guards: a town's GuardFaction, IsGuardFaction together with GuardDialogueFaction, or Raven Rock's guard. A count by name, for entry 321.
columns.holdFrom: how the hold was worked out: its own location, the cell it stands in, the ground it stands on, the nearest named place within six cells, or whose law it answers to. "nothing placed it" is the no hold column.
columns.offAtStart: traders and transport that start switched off, by their own flag or by an enable parent, so nobody is standing there. Listed so a name is never lost without a trace. offAtStartBy counts every column.
columns.sellers: every vendor faction behind a trader standing in the world, and how many traders it makes. A mod that set the vendor flag on a crowd shows here.
columns.traders: a member at rank 0 or above of a faction with the vendor flag and a buy and sell list, which is a vendor in the game's own terms. "because" names that faction.
columns.transport: a member of a carriage or ferry faction, or Gjalund Salt-Sage, the Solstheim ferry, who is in none.
columns.unique: the record carries the unique flag: a person with a name of their own rather than one of a crowd.
